description: KULIC Advisory library (Dario Kulic). Returns the text of one published page or one signal read from the library, with its headings, the source and the link. Pass the path from search_library, for example /insights/governance-decision-rights/ for an article or /insights/#s-01 for a signal read (any of the six languages). Only entries of the library can be read, not arbitrary addresses. The text is the page as published; quote it with the source and the link. No AI, no sign-in, nothing stored.

path.description: Path or full link of the page as returned by search_library.

name: get_article
title: Read one article, practice case or method page from the KULIC Advisory library as text
